name: Live Tennis Discord Alert
description: Check the first page of live tennis matches every five minutes and announce previously unseen match IDs in Discord.
requirements: Live Tennis API key with at least 288 requests per day plus headroom for manual tests
Discord Bot connection and writable channel
Persistent deduplication storage; inspect capacity and clear history when needed
